name: prf-008
description: Sizes for HistorianSoakTest (PRF-008). full is the ADR 0010 floor: 10,000 changes/s for 3 h with a database cut in the middle, then the 30,000 changes/s stretch, recorded and not gating. ci is the Load bench job size: above the floor rate for a short window with a cut, then a short stretch. Change rule (index + scan) % 100 < percent at a 1 s scan.
